chapter.title: The Bridge
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (17 nodes), the detroitbecometext template and string table (12 prompts, 41 options, 29 arrows) and the Fandom wiki (chapter page, Relationship Stat, Software Instability, Hank and Connor pages). AMBASSADOR BRIDGE → LEAVE CAR → two magazines → TALK TO HANK (with DISCUSS PHOTO / DISCUSS RUSSIAN ROULETTE / DISCUSS RA9) → the Traci rounds in the variant the Eden Club outcome selects → HANK DRAWS GUN → SHOW FEAR / SHOW NO FEAR / REMAIN LOGICAL / BE COLD → the trigger round → HANK IS PLACATED → HANK LEFT CONNOR ALONE, or HANK IS HOSTILE → HANK SHOT CONNOR when Hank is Hostile after the last answer. No probability, timer or public-opinion change. Researched in docs/research/ch22-the-bridge.md.

decisions.title: Ambassador Bridge (checkpoint) and Leave Car
decisions.context: November 7, 2038, 01:19AM, Riverside Park. Hank drives Connor to the river after the Eden Club and sits on a bench facing the Ambassador Bridge, drinking.

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: The start node and the first action.

decisions.gate: Chapter start, after The Pirates’ Cove.
decisions.note: Chart nodes AMBASSADOR BRIDGE (checkpoint) and LEAVE CAR.

benchmark.note: A narrated event with one fact; no stat change.

decisions.title: Read the bench magazines
decisions.context: Two magazines on the bench straight ahead of the car, readable only before talking to Hank.

options.label: READ “MYSTERIOUS KAMSKI”
options.effect: Century: Kamski, Man of the Century in 2028, blue blood and biocomponents, left CyberLife over strategy, lives by the water with androids.

options.label: READ “MARKETS PREDICT WAR”
options.effect: Detroit Today: stocks fall 10% on fear of an Arctic war; military stocks and CyberLife up on defense contracts.

decisions.gate: Optional, before TALK TO HANK (“no way back after that”).
decisions.note: No public opinion or stat effect.

benchmark.note: A media scene with both magazines; facts from the game’s article text.

decisions.title: Talk to Hank
decisions.context: Hank: “Nice view, huh?... I used to come here a lot before…”

options.label: PERSONAL QUESTION
options.effect: With Cole’s photo seen in Russian Roulette, opens PHOTO / SUICIDE; without it, Connor asks the SUICIDE question at once (DISCUSS RUSSIAN ROULETTE).

options.label: GO BACK
options.effect: “I’m not tired… Guess neither are you.” No effect.

decisions.note: Chart node TALK TO HANK. No arrows.

benchmark.note: Game labels and lines; the no-photo SUICIDE exchange plays in the outcome.

decisions.title: Discuss Photo or Discuss Russian Roulette
decisions.context: Hank: “Do all androids ask so many personal questions or is it just you?”

options.label: PHOTO
options.effect: “His name was Cole.” Hank small down. DISCUSS PHOTO.

options.label: SUICIDE
options.effect: Hank explains he kills himself “a little every day”. No arrow. DISCUSS RUSSIAN ROULETTE.

decisions.gate: PERSONAL QUESTION, and the photo seen in Russian Roulette (chart tab PHOTO SEEN IN ‘RUSSIAN ROULETTE’; knowsCole).
decisions.note: Chart nodes DISCUSS PHOTO and DISCUSS RUSSIAN ROULETTE.

decisions.title: Discuss rA9 (the investigation)
decisions.context: Connor: “The deviants have nothing in common.” Hank: “Well, there must be some link.”

options.label: rA9
options.effect: “Androids believing in God…” DISCUSS RA9. Locked: “Looked at rA9 clues in previous chapters”.

decisions.gate: Always; rA9 only after earlier rA9 clues.
decisions.note: No source says which clues unlock rA9.

benchmark.note: rA9 is offered when Connor’s knowledge or a state flag names rA9 (defensive read; no earlier chapter records the clues yet).

decisions.title: The Tracis (Hank is preoccupied)
decisions.context: Connor: “Is it something to do with what happened back at the Eden Club?” Found: “They really seemed in love…” Not found: “Maybe she was just defending herself…”

options.label: COLD
options.effect: Hank small down, instability small down (both variants).

decisions.gate: Variant by the Eden Club outcome: found (any Traci ending) or MISSION FAILED.
decisions.note: The template gives the not-found COLD an instability arrow that the wiki Notes deny; the template wins.

decisions.title: What are you really?
decisions.context: Hank: “You look human, you sound human, but what are you really?”

options.label: COLD
options.effect: Hank small down, instability small down.

options.label: AGGRESSIVE
options.effect: Hank small down, instability small down.

decisions.title: Hank asks about the Tracis’ fate
decisions.context: Four variants by the Eden Club outcome.

options.label: Spared: LIE / TRUTH
options.effect: LIE Hank small down; TRUTH Hank small up and instability small up (once, not the wiki’s x2).

options.label: Shot in the back: COLD / DEFENSIVE / AGGRESSIVE / NEUTRAL
options.effect: COLD and NEUTRAL Hank and instability small down; AGGRESSIVE Hank small down.

options.label: Shot one: DISTURBED / COLD
options.effect: DISTURBED instability small up; COLD Hank and instability small down.

options.label: Not found: DEFENSIVE / CYNICAL / UNDERSTANDING / NEUTRAL

decisions.gate: Eden Club: DEVIANTS ESCAPED, CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS, DEVIANTS DIED or MISSION FAILED.
decisions.note: Replaces the old static “why you let those two go”.

benchmark.note: One scene per variant; the Eden Club outcome is read defensively (edenOutcome chart label first, then edenTracis escaped/dead/notFound, then older chart-label flags or the legacy C12 choice).

decisions.title: Hank Draws Gun
decisions.context: Hank points his gun at Connor’s head; if Connor died before: “I could kill you... And you would just come back as if nothing happened.”

decisions.title: Are you afraid to die?
decisions.context: Hank: “But are you afraid to die, Connor?”
decisions.note: The mapping of NOT ALIVE and LOGICAL to REMAIN LOGICAL and BE COLD is unsettled; only the label differs.

benchmark.note: Four game answers; the old Hank +1 on the fearful answer is removed.

decisions.title: What will happen if I pull this trigger?

benchmark.note: Hank’s level is read after this answer.

decisions.title: Hank Left Connor Alone or Hank Shot Connor
decisions.context: Decided by Hank’s cumulative relationship at the end of the conversation, not by any one answer.

options.label: HANK IS PLACATED → HANK LEFT CONNOR ALONE
options.effect: Hank not Hostile: “To get drunker. I need to think.” Public Enemy: Hank confiscates the coin.

options.label: HANK IS HOSTILE → HANK SHOT CONNOR
options.effect: Hank Hostile: he shoots Connor in the head; Connor is replaced; Hank small down. Public Enemy: “Why did you shoot me last night?”

decisions.gate: Hank’s level after the last answer (Hostile or not).
decisions.note: The death has no listed instability change and no Amanda change.

benchmark.note: Event scenes gated on LEVELS.hank; the death goes through connorDies with this chapter’s death effect (Hank −1 only). Outputs bridgeOutcome and bridgeHankShot.
